meta_description: Plan an unforgettable getaway to Florida when you book 1235 Western Lake Drive, a 4-bed 4-bath WaterColor rental home with room for 10 guests. Book your stay here!
description_expanded:
Bluegrass Breeze | Camp District, Watercolor

1235 Western Lake Drive, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Ideally located in the Camp District of Watercolor sits Bluegrass Breeze | 1235 Western Lake Drive, a cozy 4 bedroom home. This residence will capture you with its light and bright interior that has been beautifully designed. Complete with 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms + golf cart/LSV, this home can comfortably accommodate 10 guests during your stay.

The first floor treats you to an open concept main living room that flows effortlessly to the dining and kitchen. The kitchen is complete with stainless steel appliances, a stunning dining table that can seat 8 guests and bar stool seating for 4 guests. The master bedroom is on this floor with a king size bed and private bathroom with a shower and soaking tub. Next, you will find a guest bedroom with a queen sized bed and bathroom with hall access. The laundry room is also on this floor. The screened in porch is a lovely place to unwind after a long day at the beach or Camp Watercolor.

The second floor of this home has two guest bedrooms. The first bedroom features a king sized bed with a private bathroom. The next bedroom is a great space for the kiddos, featuring 2 twin over twin bunk beds and a private bathroom. There is a seating space on the second floor with a tv that is perfect for enjoying a movie after a day at the beach or Camp Watercolor!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

First Floor

- Master bedroom with a king sized bed and a private bathroom with a shower and soaking tub

- Guest bedroom with a queen sized bed and bathroom with hall access

- Gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances and bar stool seating for 4 guests

- Stylish dining room table with seating for 8 guests

- Beautiful living room with comfortable seating

- Laundry room

Second Floor

- Guest bedroom with king size bed and private bathroom

- Guest bedroom with two twin over twin bunk beds and private bathroom

- 6 Seat golf cart/LSV

- Outdoor shower

- Parking for 2 vehicles

- 4 beach cruiser bicycles

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Parking for 2 vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart/LSV per address- you may not rent a second cart/LSV if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart/LSV rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart/LSV rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts/LSVs.

- This home has a video/audio capturing doorbell mounted by the door and/or exterior cameras for safety.

- 10 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
